policy: Reviewed source facts and unchanged-engine sensitivity only. Existing explicit model-eligibility holds remain in force. No challenger promotion, canonical input update, prospective seal or 2026 outcome scoring.

interpretation.canonicalCurrentDate: Existing canonical registry re-aged to the current evidence date. This is not a newly published canonical forecast.

scenarios.morgan_only: Adds only the directly captured 26–29 October Morgan primary composition.
scenarios.newspoll_and_morgan: Adds Morgan plus corroborated Newspoll toplines; Newspoll remains secondary-captured.
scenarios.expanded_current_evidence: Adds the prior DemosAU/RedBridge/Resolve sensitivity set plus the latest Newspoll and Morgan waves; admission holds remain.

interpretation.council: Roy Morgan July-September regional evidence is recorded but is not injected into the STV model until a complete five-way regional table is captured without inference. Council changes in these scenarios therefore arise only from statewide polling changes, not the new regional Roy Morgan dataset.

assemblyPolls.method: internet panels; effective margin of error reported as +/-4.1%
assemblyPolls.blocker: Primary publication now resolves the earlier topline/method/residual blocker; repeat-respondent or cross-wave sample independence is not disclosed, so canonical model admission remains an explicit owner decision.

assemblyPolls.method: online panel; quotas for age, gender, location, education and 2025 federal vote; rim weighted across age, gender, education, religion and location; undecided leaner; unresolved respondents excluded

twoPartyPreferred.basis: respondent allocated; topline corroborated by multiple contemporary polling ledgers

assemblyPolls.blocker: The existing owner rule for RedBridge/Accent requires documented respondent/sample-family independence from prior waves. The October methodology confirms a separate fieldwork window but does not disclose cross-wave respondent reuse.

assemblyPolls.method: published media poll; primary-source methodology not captured in the project evidence trail
assemblyPolls.blocker: Primary pollster/publisher methodology and a canonical primary-source capture remain required under the existing project policy.

assemblyPolls.method: Online survey; publisher reports theoretical margin of error 3.4 percentage points; full wave methodology not captured
assemblyPolls.blocker: Primary publisher full-wave capture and questionnaire/base verification remain required; corroborated toplines support sensitivity use only.

assemblyPolls.method: SMS; representative Victoria-wide cross-section; effective sample size, detailed weighting, undecided treatment and repeat-respondent overlap not disclosed in captured release
assemblyPolls.blocker: Explicit wave-admission decision required; record undisclosed effective N, undecided treatment and overlap. Erroneous Coalition/ONP pair excluded separately; primary composition sums to 100.

councilEvidence.reasonNotInjected: The published prose exposes the four major-party regional values needed for most regions but does not expose the complete five-way primary table for every region in machine-readable text. Do not infer missing ONP/OTH values for Northern Metropolitan or Southern Metropolitan.
